Resolves #18113

Extends `Neo.component.Base#nativeDragZone`, `Neo.grid.Body`, and `Neo.main.addon.NativeDragSource` with explicit `{record.<field>}` payload template tokens resolved synchronously from a pre-pushed `records` map (`data-record-id -> {field: value}`). Record-rendering subclasses (`Neo.grid.Body#buildNativeDragZoneRecords`) project only their currently rendered row pool (`items`) keyed strictly by `data-record-id` (never pooled DOM slot ids `__row-N` or unrendered store records) and refresh the projection on their render pass (`createViewData` / `onStoreRecordChange`), decoupling `nativeDragZone` from `useInternalId: false` while keeping existing DOM attribute tokens (`{data-record-id}`) and attribute-only registrations unchanged.

Evidence: L2 (20/20 unit specs in NativeDragSource.spec.mjs and NativeDragZone.spec.mjs green in Playwright Node runner; all 6 ACs are pure in-process component/addon template and row-render refresh invariants) → L2 required.

The addon half is what the ticket asked for: an explicit `{record.<field>}` form no shipped declaration can collide with (the old `[\w-]+` never matched a dot), resolved synchronously from memory, with attribute tokens untouched. ### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #18113 (my ticket: Contract Ledger, AC-1..AC-6, Avoided Traps); dev `src/main/addon/NativeDragSource.mjs` (`templateToken`, `onDragStart`, `register`, `sourceOf`); dev `src/component/Base.mjs` (`afterSetNativeDragZone`, the generation-guarded `registerNativeDragZone`, `retireNativeDragZone`, the `afterSetWindowId` re-registration); `src/grid/Body.mjs` (`getRowId`, `getRecordId`, `afterSetStartIndex`, `createViewData`); `src/data/Store.mjs` (`getAt` → `hydrateRecord`).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** An explicit record-field token, a node-key → `{field: value}` map pushed ahead of `dragstart` and consulted before `getAttribute`, synchronous at resolution. Only a mounted node can start a drag, so the map should hold the rendered rows' records, keyed by the id the DOM already carries (`data-record-id`), and refreshed by the component that renders them. It must not hardcode one component's internals into `component.Base`, and it must not hydrate or walk a whole store. Isolation: addon specs on fake nodes, plus a component spec whose row node looks like a real pooled row.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches on the addon; contradicts on the component. `buildNativeDragZoneRecords` walks `store.getAt(0..count)`, Base enumerates `[me, me.body, me.bodyStart, me.bodyEnd]` and their row `items`, and `resolveRecord` checks `node.id` before `data-record-id`. The evidence is the three source facts in the Required Actions.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with the ticket's own value: it set out to replace a silent wrong payload with a correct one. RA-3 matters because the pooled-id lookup can reintroduce a silent wrong payload in a narrower window.
